objectives.performance: Structure an explanation of a complex technical issue for a non-specialist audience
conditions: Given a complex technical issue
Given a non-specialist audience
success_criteria: Explanation follows a logical structure (problem, context, solution/impact)

Audience can demonstrate understanding of the core issue

assessments.capability_claim: Learner can structure and adapt a technical explanation for a non-specialist audience

required_evidence.criterion: Explanation presents a logical structure with identifiable problem statement, context, and solution or impact sections

Explanation includes at least one concrete example or analogy to support non-specialist comprehension

task.description: Given a technical issue description (e.g., database replication lag, API rate limiting, or memory leak), produce a written or oral explanation intended for a non-technical stakeholder. The explanation should be 300-500 words or 2-3 minutes in length.
conditions: Technical issue is provided in advance or selected from a set
Target audience profile is specified (e.g., business manager, customer support lead)
No technical jargon dictionary or glossary is provided

Partial structure; some logical sequencing but missing key sections
Clear structure with problem, context, and solution/impact identifiable
Exemplary structure with smooth transitions and audience-appropriate pacing

Some terms adapted but key jargon remains unexplained
Most technical terms replaced or defined; accessible to non-specialists
All terminology carefully chosen; definitions integrated naturally
Abstract presentation; no examples or contextual aids
Limited use of examples; may not align with audience experience
Effective use of at least one concrete example or analogy
Multiple well-chosen examples; anticipates and addresses likely audience questions

scoring.mastery_rule: Learner must achieve level 3 or 4 on all three dimensions

prerequisites.capability: Identify characteristics and knowledge constraints of a non-specialist audience
prerequisites.rationale: Without ability to identify audience characteristics, learner cannot determine which technical terms require adaptation or what level of abstraction is appropriate. Required for evidence criterion ev-tc-001-a-2 (terminology adaptation) and ev-tc-001-a-3 (concrete examples aligned to audience).

prerequisites.capability: Comprehend the technical issue sufficiently to extract core problem, context, and impact
prerequisites.rationale: Learner must understand the technical issue before explaining it. Without this comprehension, learner cannot identify what constitutes the problem statement, relevant context, or solution/impact (success criterion 1 of obj-tc-001 and evidence criterion ev-tc-001-a-1). Instruction assumes technical issue understanding as input.

modules.title: Structuring Technical Explanations for Non-Specialist Audiences
